title: pyrus autumnalis
intro: Pyrus autumnalis, commonly known as the Korean mountain apple, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its edible fruit, which is rich in antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals, offering various health benefits such as improving cardiovascular health, reducing inflammation, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus autumnalis include anti-diabetic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and organic acids. The bioactive constituents in Pyrus autumnalis have been shown to exhibit potential in preventing chronic diseases and promoting overall well-being.
